g.title: existing_project
g.text: Existing project: start to the spec-phase tail

g.title: tonext
g.text: this work is a later commitment

g.title: pending
g.text: the later start points back to the superseded record

g.title: supersede
g.text: close old range with decision, transition id and slug;
carry open obligations; do not name a future start

g.title: readspec
g.text: Path B: read glossary, keystone, domains,

g.title: migrate
g.text: Migrate: tell the developer, on ok remove the 1.x record
directories (history keeps them); convert the spec in place
until cairn lint docs/spec is clean, changing no requirement's words;

g.title: init
g.text: Ask the developer: authority remote or local-only,
signed or attested; cairn init with the answers as flags

g.title: carry
g.text: Carry: one cairn item per 1.x item file;

g.title: recon
g.text: manifests, entry points, data, tests, CI, scripts,

g.title: ask
g.text: feature to add or defect to fix?

g.title: pathA
g.text: Path A: glossary from code identifiers;
Observed specs in radius; map rows outside

g.title: pathB
g.text: Path B: verify every spec section in radius

g.title: confirm
g.text: Confirmed Observed sections become Draft with falsifiers;
others remain Observed and are not contract

g.title: specwrong
g.text: Spec wrong: revise by developer ruling

g.title: roadmap
g.text: Prepare roadmap section; a defect commitment names
the violated requirement and reproducing mechanism

g.title: tail
g.text: start (with supersession link when present), wake
